program.intent: Pack the full timestamp into epoch seconds for compact storage.
program.code:
def forward(groups):
    weekday, sp1, month, sp2, day, sp3, time, sp4, year = groups
    text = weekday + ' ' + month + ' ' + day + ' ' + time + ' ' + year
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%a %b %d %H:%M:%S %Y')
    return {'stored': [int(dt.timestamp())], 'layout': [len(sp1), len(sp2), len(sp3), len(sp4)]}

def inverse(record):
    stored_value = record['stored'][0]
    layout = record['layout']
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(stored_value)
    weekday = dt.strftime('%a')
    month = dt.strftime('%b')
    day = str(dt.day).zfill(2)
    time = dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
    year = dt.strftime('%Y')
    return weekday + (' ' * layout[0]) + month + (' ' * layout[1]) + day + (' ' * layout[2]) + time + (' ' * layout[3]) + year
